scope: Node VM tests of actual prototype Git models, callbacks and exported history helpers. Only audit evidence files are written; Git commands, application disk writes, repository backend and browser UI were not executed. History annotation expectations apply to the explicit demo fixtures, not to general Git blame semantics.

tests.name: Hunks retain two separately selectable groups
Selected lines deduplicate and reject context or invalid indices
Selecting all changed rows becomes full staging; unstage removes selection
Partial commit preserves unstaged remainder and unrelated file
Full commit removes only fully staged file from changes
Empty commit and message do not mutate history
Commit callback blocks dirty editor buffers
Staging detects later working-copy edits rather than silently committing new content
Amend replaces HEAD without adding a second commit or duplicating a path
Message-only amend preserves prior commit file snapshot
Snapshot is a deep copy including stage selection
Stash callback captures diff and index then removes matching changes
Apply keeps original stash and restores exact captured index and diff
Pop deletes stash only after successful restoration
Conflicting pop retains saved source and working copy unchanged
Dirty editor collision blocks restore without deleting source
Shelf is independent of Git stash; keep preserves working copy
Legacy metadata-only stash is not reported as restored
Operation callback rejects changed project
Operation callback rejects changed branch
Operation callback rejects changed HEAD between preview and apply
New branch with checkout respects dirty-buffer guard
Invalid references and duplicate branches are rejected
History-transform plans leave graph unchanged
Project models and drafts are independent instances
Icon buttons contain a single class attribute
Stage-visible respects search and preserves an already staged hidden file
Stage-visible respects author and changelist filters
Empty file filter stages nothing
Filtered history cannot show the hidden selected commit detail
No matching history results leave no stale detail action
Operation callback rejects changed repository
Restored stash retains staging fingerprint so later changes require restage
Operation text and unchecked-checkbox draft survive a model rerender
Returning from operation preview retains entered values
Stale index view shows the saved snapshot and blocks misleading current content
Index-view hunk action maps back to original selected row indices
Both reference validators reject control bytes and DEL
History branch validation accepts useful names and rejects malformed references
History diff reconstructs both original inputs with consistent row numbers
History identical revisions show no additions or removals
History fixture annotations retain source revisions and one-based rows
History capture is stable after the live model changes
